name: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Agri-Food Sector
description: This course provides training in the application of artificial intelligence (AI) across the agri-food sector; from precision agriculture and smart supply chains to food quality monitoring and sustainability forecasting. Students will learn to use machine learning models, computer vision, IoT-integrated AI, and decision support systems, with hands-on case studies and datasets relevant to real-world agri-food challenges. Emphasis will be placed on algorithm selection, data lifecycle, model interpretability, and ethical AI use.
